heard: A meteorite hit a sleeping woman in her own home. It bounced off a radio, bruising Ann Hodges. The Air Force seized it, but her landlord claimed ownership. Mrs. Guy argued property rights over the space rock. The family paid $500 to keep and sell it. Public interest? Fanished, forcing them to donate the rock. Meanwhile, farmer Julius McKinney found a second meteorite fragment. He sold it to the Smithsonian, buying a house and car. Not everyone profits when a meteorite hits a sleeping woman.
